cohort: The cohort included 308 pregnant women aged 20-35, without underlying diseases, with at least one previous pregnancy and childbirth, divided into groups based on the presence or absence of a previous cesarean section.
finding: Previous cesarean section significantly increases uterine artery resistance and the incidence of pre-eclampsia in subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section significantly increases uterine artery resistance and the incidence of pre-eclampsia in subsequent pregnancies.
gest_age: Average gestational age was 37.54 ± 1.4 weeks in the C/S group and 38.01 ± 1.99 weeks in the non-C/S group.
